events.title: Canada’s Largest Ribfest
events.summary: Four days of rib teams, music and fundraising on Burlington’s waterfront.
events.details: The festival runs 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. Friday through Sunday and 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. Monday. Food and drinks cost extra after admission.
bring: A plan for transit or parking
events.imageAlt: Ribs cooking over a barbecue pit
events.credit: Thogru via Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 3.0

events.title: Royal Canadian Circus
events.summary: The touring circus’s Burlington stop, with multiple daily shows over the Labour Day weekend.
events.details: Official tickets list Thursday 7:30 p.m.; Friday 4 and 7:30 p.m.; Saturday and Sunday 12, 4 and 7:30 p.m.; Monday 11 a.m. and 3 p.m. Doors open 30–45 minutes before showtime. Children 3 and under are free on an adult’s lap. Use the mall parking lot.
bring: A parking plan for Burlington Centre
events.imageAlt: The red-and-yellow Royal Canadian Circus big top at Burlington Centre.

events.title: RBG After Dark: ANCHORBALL
events.summary: A 19+ evening walk through the ANCHORBALL sculptures with food, drinks and live entertainment.
events.details: Royal Botanical Gardens lists the remaining After Dark date as Sept. 5. Final entry is 9 p.m. Separate evening tickets are required. This is not the daytime garden admission.
bring: Photo ID if you look under 25
A payment card for food or drinks
events.imageAlt: Rock Garden at Royal Botanical Gardens
events.credit: Nhl4hamilton via Wikimedia Commons · public domain

events.title: Movies Under the Stars: Lilo & Stitch
events.dateLabel: Thu, Sept. 3 · 8 p.m. at Ireland Park
events.summary: The official City table also lists a September 3 screening at Ireland Park.
events.details: The City page intro says the series runs through August 27, but the published schedule table includes Thursday, September 3 at Ireland Park for Lilo & Stitch 2025. Confirm closer to the date.
bring: A weather check before you leave
events.imageAlt: Editorial reconstruction of a community outdoor movie night in a park.

events.title: Winona Peach Festival
events.location: Winona Park, 1328 Barton Street, Stoney Creek
events.travel: About 25 minutes east of Burlington along the QEW
events.summary: A free three-day peach festival with food, live music, crafts and a midway.
events.details: This is a nearby Stoney Creek festival, not a Burlington event. Hours are Friday 5 to 11 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Admission ends at 9:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday. The official site says bag checks and metal detectors are in use.
bring: A bag that is easy to check
A plan for parking or the HSR shuttle
events.imageAlt: Baskets of ripe peaches on a market table.

events.title: Elizabeth Gardens Art Walk
events.location: Lions Park and Lions Hall, 471 Pearl Street
events.summary: A free outdoor art walk with local artists, hands-on activities and live music.
events.details: The Elizabeth Gardens Creative Collective lists the sixth annual Art Walk as rain or shine. Admission is free. The organizers describe outdoor exhibitions, demos, a scavenger hunt and kids’ activities.
bring: Cash or a card for art you want to buy
events.imageAlt: Burlington News editorial graphic for Art Walk

events.title: Watch Burlington’s partial lunar eclipse
events.dateLabel: Thu, Aug. 27 · partial phase at 10:33 p.m.
events.location: Visible across Burlington with a clear view of the sky
events.summary: The partial eclipse begins at 10:33 p.m. and reaches maximum at 12:12 a.m.
events.details: The penumbral phase starts at 9:23 p.m. The partial phase starts at 10:33 p.m., reaches maximum at 12:12 a.m. and ends at 1:51 a.m. No eye protection is required for a lunar eclipse.
events.imageAlt: Night-sky illustration above the Niagara Escarpment. Not a Burlington photograph of this eclipse.
events.venue: Anywhere with a clear view of the sky

events.title: Movies Under the Stars: Ice Princess
events.dateLabel: Thu, Aug. 27 · 8 p.m. at Kilbride Park
events.summary: The City’s free outdoor movie series ends Thursday with Ice Princess.
events.details: Access Storage Movies Under the Stars is a Thursday series. The official City schedule lists Ice Princess at Kilbride Park on August 27. Bring a chair or blanket. Weather can cancel the show; the City posts cancellations by 3 p.m. There is no verified Friday, August 28 movie night.
bring: A weather check before you leave
events.imageAlt: Editorial reconstruction of a community outdoor movie night in a park. Not a photograph of Kilbride Park.
